description.value: The Peri Peri Shack is a flame-grilled peri peri chicken restaurant drawing on the African and Portuguese culinary tradition of the Peri-Peri pepper, with chicken marinated 24 hours in a secret spice blend before grilling. Cyclists can choose from seven flavour profiles ranging from Plain and Mild through Citrus & Herb, Mango, and Hot up to the signature Peri Nero. The restaurant also offers catering and sharing packs suited for groups.
